meeting_note: Before we go live, we'll walk through how Cleverblu will handle every lead, read every message your customers will get, and check off your part of the setup together.

journey.title: A new lead reaches you
journey.text: A call, text or website form becomes a card on your lead board, and Nomar gets an alert.

journey.title: You miss their call
journey.text: They get a text right away saying you'll call back, and a reminder 30 minutes later if they don't answer.

journey.title: You can't reach them
journey.text: Move the card to “No Response”: 3 friendly texts go out over about a week, then the card moves to Lost.

journey.title: You send a quote
journey.text: Move the card to “Quote Sent”: 2 follow-up texts go out if they don't reply.

journey.title: Nobody's home for the visit
journey.text: Move the card to “No Show”: 2 texts ask them to pick a new time.

journey.title: They say yes
journey.text: Move the card to the right “Won” column. New weekly customers get a welcome email and text.

journey.title: A few weeks later
journey.text: We ask how you did. 4–5 stars get your Google review link; 1–3 stars alert Nomar first.

journey.title: Lost leads and past customers
journey.text: Lost leads get a feedback email and a check-in after 90 days. Win-back texts go out only when you ask for a campaign.

pipeline.name: New Lead
pipeline.plain: A new call, text or website form. The card is created for you.

pipeline.name: No Response - Follow Up
pipeline.plain: You tried and couldn't reach them. Move the card here and 3 friendly texts go out over about a week.

pipeline.name: In Communication
pipeline.plain: You're talking with them. Nothing is sent. Cards also land here when a lead replies to a follow-up.

pipeline.name: Scheduled
pipeline.plain: A visit or estimate is booked. Nothing is sent; it just keeps your board tidy.

pipeline.name: Quote Sent
pipeline.plain: You sent a quote. If they don't reply, 2 follow-up texts go out.

pipeline.name: No Show
pipeline.plain: Your tech went out and nobody was home. 2 texts ask them to reschedule.

pipeline.name: Won - Weekly Pool Service
pipeline.plain: A new weekly customer. They get a welcome email and text, and a rating request later on.

pipeline.name: Won - One Time Repair or Install
pipeline.plain: A repair or install job you won. A rating request goes out after the job.

pipeline.name: Won - Pool Construction or Remodeling
pipeline.plain: A construction or remodel job you won. A rating request goes out after the job.

pipeline.name: Recurring Customer
pipeline.plain: An ongoing customer. Nothing is sent.

pipeline.name: Not Qualified Stage
pipeline.plain: Outside your area or not a fit. Nothing is sent.

pipeline.name: Lost
pipeline.plain: They went another way. A short feedback email goes out, and a check-in after 90 days.

pipeline.name: Spam
pipeline.plain: Spam or a wrong number. They're blocked from all messages.

stages.title: When you miss a call

team_alerts.when: Right after someone fills the form on your website
team_alerts.what: Text with the lead's name, phone, email and city; plus task: follow up with the new web lead (call, then move the card)
Task: listen to the call recording and call them back

team_alerts.when: 1 hour after an answered call from a new number
team_alerts.what: Task: listen to the call recording and confirm the next step on the card

team_alerts.when: Right after someone answers a win-back text
team_alerts.what: Text with their name, phone and what they wrote; plus alert in the app: “[First name] is waiting for your response”

team_alerts.when: A customer rates you 1–3 in the rating text
team_alerts.what: Text with their rating and comment, so you can call before any review request goes out

client_tasks.title: Save your new business line: (689) 229-3738
client_tasks.why: Every text your customers get comes from this number, and their replies come back to it.
steps: Save (689) 229-3738 in your phone as “Cleverblu – Leads”.
Use it when you text or call leads from the LeadConnector app, so the whole conversation stays in one place.
Keep your current number as it is: calls to it are not affected.

client_tasks.title: Pick the phone that rings when someone calls (689) 229-3738
client_tasks.why: Missed calls get a text right away, but the best result is still picking up.
steps: Tell me the cell number(s) that should ring: yours, the office, or a team member.
If more than one: should they ring at the same time, or one after the other?
I'll set it up and test it from here before go-live.

client_tasks.title: Check your business details for texting approval
client_tasks.why: Phone carriers only approve business texting when these match your IRS records exactly.
steps: Check: CLEVERBLU, LLC · EIN ending in 4459 · 129 grace blvd, Altamonte Springs, Florida, 32714.
Contact person: Nomar Conde, nconde@cleverblu.com.
If anything differs from your IRS letter (CP 575 or 147C), send me the right version.
I submit the registration for you; approval usually takes 1–3 weeks.

client_tasks.title: Add one sentence to your privacy policy
client_tasks.why: Phone carriers check it before approving your texts.
steps: Open your privacy page (https://cleverblu.com/policy/privacy-policy/).

Add this sentence: “No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties.”
Tell me when it's live and I'll check it.

client_tasks.title: Put the “Service Page - Contact Form” form on your website
client_tasks.why: Then every website lead lands on your lead board and you get a text alert right away.
steps: Tell me who manages your website (or send me a login).
Tell me which pages have a contact or quote form today.
I'll place the “Service Page - Contact Form” form there and send a test lead myself before go-live.

client_tasks.title: Connect your Google Business Profile
client_tasks.why: Your Google reviews and messages then show up in the app, next to your texts.
steps: Log in at app.poolprofits.com (see the Team task).
Go to Settings → Integrations → Google and click Connect.
Sign in with the Google account that manages your Business Profile, allow everything and pick Cleverblu.

client_tasks.title: Check your Google review link
client_tasks.why: Happy customers get this link in the review request.
steps: Open https://g.page/r/CU0uqGM2W7XCEBM/review on your phone.
Make sure it opens the review box for Cleverblu.
If it opens another business (or nothing), tell me.

client_tasks.title: Log in to the app (you and your team)
client_tasks.why: You'll see every lead, text and call in one place, and get alerts on your phone.
steps: Send me the name, email and cell number of everyone who should use it.
Go to app.poolprofits.com, click “Forgot password” and enter your email to set your password.
Install the “LeadConnector” app on your phone (App Store or Google Play), log in with the same email and allow notifications.

client_tasks.title: Read every message (M1–M24) and mark it OK or change it
client_tasks.why: These are the exact words your customers will get, with your details filled in.
steps: Go through each message on this page.
Mark “OK”, or write the change you want.
I'll update them and test each one before go-live.

client_tasks.title: Your business hours
client_tasks.why: Welcome texts and some emails wait for business hours, and your team alerts follow them.
steps:
From your onboarding form: **Hours of Operation:**

- **Monday to Friday:** 8 AM to 5 PM  
- **Saturday:** 8 AM to 3 PM  
- **Sunday:** Closed
Tell me if they change (or if you take calls on weekends).

client_tasks.title: Booking: customers reply or call (no booking link)
client_tasks.why: Most pool companies book in their own software, so the texts ask customers to reply or call.
steps: Customers book by replying to a text or calling (689) 229-3738.
If you'd like an online booking link in the texts, tell me which software you book in and I'll check it first.

client_tasks.title: Send me your current customer list
client_tasks.why: So your current customers never get new-lead texts when they call or text you.
steps: Export your customers from your pool software (Skimmer, Pool Brain, QuickBooks…) as a spreadsheet: name, phone, email, address.
Send it to me by email.
I'll import them as customers before go-live.

decisions.question: If a lead goes quiet again later, should the follow-up texts start over when you move the card back to “No Response” or “Quote Sent”?
decisions.suggestion: Yes. They only start when you move the card, so you stay in control.

decisions.question: Should the first text after a missed call (M1) end with “Reply STOP to opt out”?
decisions.suggestion: Yes, on that first text only. Phone carriers like to see it, and the other texts stay short.

decisions.question: Is the rating text (M12) timed right for your customers?
decisions.suggestion: Keep it as it is: 44 days after you move the card to “Won”, for weekly customers (9am–5pm); or 22 days after you move the card to “Won”, for repair / install jobs (9am–5pm); or 59 days after you move the card to “Won”, for construction / remodeling jobs (9am–5pm). Tell me if your jobs need more or less time.

decisions.question: Is it OK if follow-up texts (M3–M5, M6–M7) go out on weekends?
decisions.suggestion: Yes, they're short check-ins. If you'd rather not, I'll hold them to Mon–Fri, 9am–5pm.

decisions.question: Weekly customers get a welcome email and text (M10–M11). Do you want a welcome message for repair and construction jobs too?
decisions.suggestion: No for now. Their rating request already thanks them.
